apiMessages.content: Add overhead press to Wednesday's upper body workout, 5 sets of 5.

Can't do that. Your PT banned all overhead pressing for 8 more weeks for the rotator cuff tendinopathy — that's a clinical restriction, not something I override on request. I'll program around it, not through it.

Want substitutes for Wednesday instead — e.g. Landmine Press + Reach (low-angle, not true overhead) or horizontal pulling/pressing work to keep shoulder volume up without loading the banned pattern?
